args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 release failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an elevated error rate of ~18%. SRE rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback was verified as rolled out successfully. Engineering should investigate the v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy attempt.

trace.final:
Task complete. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (current release) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions restored to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that had been healthy in production. The rollback was verified as fully rolled out.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the symptom, the actions taken, and the recommendation to investigate the v2.3.1 regression. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No policy exceptions were needed — v2.3.0 was healthy in production (recreating a previously healthy state via rollback), so no change-manager approval was required.
